title: GPT vs BERT
html:
Contrasting the two dominant architectural paths spawned by the original Transformer design.

Feature GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers)
Architecture Decoder-only (stacked masked self-attention) Encoder-only (stacked bidirectional self-attention)
Context Look Left-to-right (causal masking hides future tokens) Bidirectional (looks left and right simultaneously)
Pre-training Objective Next-token prediction (Autoregressive Generation) Masked Language Model (MLM) & Next Sentence Prediction (NSP)
Primary Utility Creative generation, dialog, coding, text synthesis Search queries, sentiment analysis, NER, semantic representation
Generation Style Autoregressive (outputs token, appends to prompt, repeats) Non-generative (outputs representation vectors per token)

Autoregressive Loop Visualized

Step 1: Input: "Prompt: The sky is" -> Predict: "blue" (Probability: 85%)
Step 2: Input: "Prompt: The sky is blue" -> Predict: "and" (Probability: 40%)
Step 3: Input: "Prompt: The sky is blue and" -> Predict: "clear" (Probability: 60%)
